subject: general
question: What is density of population in NCT of Delhi as per the 2011 Census?
solution:
The correct answer is __**11320**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **11320** is the density of population in NCT of Delhi as per the 2011 Census.
 
• The National Capital Territory (NCT) of Delhi is one of the most densely populated regions in India.
 
• Population density is calculated as the number of people per square kilometer.
 
• The high population density of Delhi reflects its status as a major urban center and capital city of India.
 
• The 2011 Census provides detailed demographic data that helps in urban planning and resource allocation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The census is conducted every ten years in India, with the latest one being in 2021.
 
• The data collected includes information on population size, density, distribution, and various socio-economic indicators.
 
• Delhi's population density has significant implications for infrastructure, public services, and urban development.
 
• Efforts are continuously made to manage the challenges arising from high population density, such as traffic congestion, pollution, and housing.
 
• Understanding population density is crucial for effective governance and policy-making in metropolitan areas.
